After any center-lane proposal, independently recheck median/whisker/point occlusion. Preserve 100 x 80 mm, 8 pt font, point area and 0–30 scale. If a readable arrangement cannot fit those constraints, record the blocker and seek an explicitly changed layout rather than reducing points/data.
